events.evidence: The International Criminal Court issues an arrest warrant for Russian president Vladimir Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova
Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan announces that Turkey will begin the process of ratifying Finland's membership of NATO without Sweden
Slovakia announces that it will donate its MiG-29 fighter jets, and supply part of its Kub air-defense system to Ukraine

label.note: ICC warrant for Putin and NATO enlargement steps raise geopolitical stakes.
